**How to falsify it:** The discovery of pathogenic variants in ALG3 and ALG11 with frequencies exceeding 1% in gnomAD would falsify the hypothesis that these genes are the primary causal agents for these rare disorders. _(variant: Pathogenic variants in ALG3 or ALG11 with allele frequency > 0.01 in gnomAD)_
